items.content: The uncomfortable question A few days ago, a customer asked me a question that sounded simple: “Argo CD said the sync succeeded, so why didn’t our migration run?” They had pushed a release while a deny sync window was active. items.summary: Self-hosting LLMs on GPUs means paying to recompute the same context on every turn. Distributed KV caching with Amazon ElastiCache can cut inference cost by up to 40% and time to first token by up to 80%. This post walks through the distributed KV caching skill in the Agent Toolkit for AWS, which evaluates and sets up the cache from your coding agent.
items.content: Customers increasingly self-host large language models (LLMs) on GPUs for control over cost, accuracy, and latency. However, self-hosting often means paying for redundant GPU work because small, isolated caches on each server can’t hold or share the growing context AI agents and chat applications resend. Consider a legal AI assistant that can accumulate hundreds of thousands of tokens of case history in each conversation.

items.content: On November 19, 2026, the Ruby team disclosed ruby2shell ( CVE-2026-132825 ), a heap buffer overflow in the way Ruby changes the case of strings. Ruby rates the flaw Critical and says it is aware of proofs of concept that achieve remote code execution in some scenarios. Fixes shipped in Ruby 3.3.14, 3.4.13, and 4.0.10 . The reach is wide. Veria Labs reports that Ruby on Rails and classic-style Sinatra applications reach the bug in their default configuration, before any authentication.

items.content: Organizations across financial services, insurance, healthcare, and the public sector depend on document processing. items.content: Large-scale model training is one of the most expensive workloads you can run on GPUs, and a single unhealthy accelerator can stall an entire distributed job. items.summary: Explore how SOC leaders can rebuild the analyst learning curve as agentic AI automates triage, preserving critical investigative judgment and bench talent.
items.content: Ask a senior analyst how they learned the job, and closing false positives rarely comes up. That work mostly built alert fatigue. The learning happened in rarer moments: the real hit, the escalation that became an incident, the Tier 2 analyst walking you through what you missed. Agentic investigation now clears much of that queue. For coverage, that's a clear win. For your bench, it removes the place where people learned. items.summary: 통장 개설 UI를 그리면서 AI와 함께 상상의 폭을 넓혀 본 과정을 소개합니다.
items.content: 안녕하세요. 토스 Visual Designer 권윤입니다. 저는 토스에 Platform Designer로 입사해 디자인 시스템인 TDS를 만들어왔어요. 디자인 토큰 체계를 만들고 컴포넌트를 설계하는 일이 주된 업무였어요. 그러다 지난 4월, Interaction Designer, Graphic Designer 등 각자의 전문성을 가진 분들과 함께 Visual Designer라는 하나의 직무로 합쳐졌어요. 솔직히 처음에는 심란했습니다. 직무 이름이 바뀐다고 하루아침에 눈길을 사로잡는 비주얼을 만들 수 있는 건 아니니까요. 저는 디자인 시스템을 만들며 정돈되고 일관된 화면을 그려온 사람이었어요. 패턴으로 정리되는 디자인에는 익숙했지만, 처음 보는 순간 시선을 붙잡는 비주얼은 늘 다른 분들의 영역이라고 생각했어요. 이럴 때 AI의 도움을 받으면 된다고들 해요. 하지만 AI는 정해진 규칙 안에서 6~7점짜리 결과물을 빠르게 만드는 데 강합니다.
